mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2.5% does not lead to tighter monetary policy within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong economic growth, boosting investor confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase > 300k does not correlate with positive economic growth indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 QoQ < -1% does not correlate with other negative economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO MoM > 1% does not correlate with other positive economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or FEDFUNDS < 0.5% does not correlate with accommodative monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or HOUST MoM < -10% does not correlate with other negative housing market indicators.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE MoM > 0.5% does not correlate with other negative labor market indicators.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) decreases and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) increases simultaneously, it signals a broad economic downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with other broad economic downturn indicators.
